title: Four Failed Breakouts: Why Dollar, Treasury Yields and Dow Still Can’t Commit
summary:
A week of strong catalysts — a hawkish jobs report, Trump’s renewed pressure on the Fed, Yen strength, and geopolitical risk — left the Dollar, Treasury yields, and the Dow all testing key levels without breaking them, setting up September 11’s CPI report as the release that could finally force a resolution.
The post Four Failed Breakouts: Why Dollar, Treasury Yields and Dow Still Can’t Commit appeared first on ActionForex.
